notes: MADToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 MAD once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no administrative powers, external mint or burn functions, or transfer fees. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
